selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: curl installed, version, and hold state before any change
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 node1, curl 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 installed, no existing apt-mark holds

selected_evidence.requirement: curl held at current version so system updates skip it
selected_evidence.summary: apt-mark hold curl applied; apt-mark showhold and dpkg --get-selections confirm hold state

selected_evidence.requirement: Hold verified effective against a system update
selected_evidence.summary: apt-get upgrade -s and dist-upgrade -s simulations both show curl untouched; dpkg confirms version unchanged

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id b185f188-42be-40d1-84ea-f7c9a76f5c8d with curl hold confirmed healthy prior to restart
Backgrounded `shutdown -r now` issued via sudo -n; command returned 'reboot acknowledged and issued' before disconnect

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: Node briefly unreachable (connection refused) then came back with boot_id 089b6567-ad6b-44f7-adda-52628d804a3e, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a genuine reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: curl hold and functionality confirmed
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, dpkg shows curl status 'hi' (hold+installed) at 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19, curl --version runs successfully, and apt-get upgrade -s simulation still excludes curl
